name: manual_8a6c43
claim: Orama swarm launch must dispatch the cached approved preview and send Perpetua top-level role, task_type, and metadata.model. Perpetua POST /models/route and POST /v1/jobs accept that shim. Do not add knowledge search, MCP, or A2A to Perpetua.

decisions.notes: 2026-09-28 portal facade audit. Rebuilding the preview on launch minted a second approval and failed the fingerprint whenever routing flickered. Job identity left only in metadata left JobSpec.role empty. Draft Perpetua-Tools #404 and orama-system branch cursor/portal-swarm-approval-fixes-3c54.
